clock_model.rtl_boundary: phase_clk_i runs at four times E; enabled rising edges advance address, AS-close, E-rise data, and E-fall data subphases
clock_model.historical_boundary: the on-chip oscillator divides by four to produce E; STBY stops the oscillator and E
clock_model.limitation: Active read/write subphase ordering and standby clock suppression are implemented; the documented three-E-cycle reset-entry delay, nanosecond limits, oscillator stabilization, pads, and electrical behavior are not

signals.name: phase_clk_i
signals.fact: four enabled rising edges represent one E cycle and no internally generated clock is used

signals.name: phase_reset_n_i
signals.fact: asynchronously initializes the subphase counter; distinct from historical RES

signals.name: clock_enable_i
signals.fact: low holds the subphase counter and normalized MCU state

signals.name: reset_n_i
signals.fact: active low resets the MCU; this wrapper immediately releases address/data outputs rather than claiming the documented third-cycle transition

signals.name: standby_n_i
signals.fact: accepted at the normalized E boundary; active standby releases buses and suppresses E

signals.name: standby_power_ok_i
signals.fact: digital retention-valid indication only

signals.name: e_o
signals.fact: low in address/AS-close phases, high in both data phases, remains active during SLP, and is low throughout accepted standby

signals.name: bus_phase_o
signals.fact: 0 address, 1 AS-close/turnaround, 2 E-rise data, and 3 E-fall data

signals.name: sc1_o
signals.historical: AS in Modes 2/4; unused in Mode 1
signals.fact: AS is high only in the multiplexed address subphase

signals.name: sc1_oe_o
signals.fact: enabled for AS in Modes 2/4 and disabled in Mode 1

signals.name: sc2_o
signals.fact: high for reads and low for writes; forced high in reset, WAI, SLP, and standby

signals.name: port1_i
signals.fact: GPIO pin samples where Port 1 remains an I/O port

signals.name: port1_o
signals.fact: dedicated low address in Mode 1 and normalized GPIO latch in Modes 2/4; Mode 1 presents FF during WAI and SLP

signals.name: port1_oe_o
signals.fact: all address bits enabled in active Mode 1; GPIO DDR in Modes 2/4; released in reset/standby

signals.name: port3_i
signals.fact: external read byte sampled before the normalized E-fall advancement boundary

signals.name: port3_o
signals.fact: write data in Mode 1; low address then write data in Modes 2/4; WAI and SLP retain the multiplexed FF address phase and release the data phase

signals.name: port3_oe_o
signals.fact: writes drive only while E is high; multiplexed low address drives before AS closes

signals.name: port4_o
signals.fact: dedicated upper address in every legal HD6303R mode and presents FF during WAI and SLP

signals.name: port4_oe_o
signals.fact: enabled during active operation and released in reset/standby

signals.name: standby_active_o
signals.fact: reports the E-synchronously accepted digital standby state

halt_interrupt_behavior: HD6303R has no HALT pin; WAI presents FFFF with high-impedance data and inactive read/write strobes while E continues, SLP retains its documented FFFF idle bus while CPU execution stops, and accepted STBY enters reset state, releases buses, and stops E
